name: print-social-grey-paper-mvp-core-action-screen-post
title: MVP Guide Core Action Screen Post
whatItIs: A grainy light-grey post with a tall condensed black headline, an orange subtitle, short explanatory copy, and a phone with an orange bezel showing a headphone product screen.
whatItMeans: Paper-like grain and orange accents feel friendly and practical. The phone shows the concept rather than just describing it.
techniques: Condensed heavy headline against light body copy
Orange accent tying the subtitle to the phone bezel
Example screen as an illustration of the lesson
Author avatar and Save for later prompt in the footer

vocabulary.definition: Fine noise overlay that gives a flat colour a paper feel.
A phone frame coloured to match the accent.
